## About
WeCare Tree Care LLC is a tree service based on Exchange Ave in Schertz. We trim and shape trees, take them down when it's time, clear moss, and clean up lots and yards so your outdoor space looks cared for.
Neighbors have given us a 5 star rating across 89 Google reviews. Give us a call or send us a note through the contact page, and we'll talk through what your property needs.

## Services
- Pruning and demossing: Trimming trees and shrubs for healthy growth, good looks and safety, plus removing unwanted moss to improve tree health and reduce the risk of damage.
- Tree trimming and removal: Shaping trees to keep your property safe and looking good, or removing them when necessary.
- Landscaping and lot cleaning: Designing landscapes and clearing debris for a clean, polished outdoor space.

## FAQ
Q: Do you clean up after the job?
A: Yes. One reviewer said their tree was removed safely and efficiently, and everything was cleaned up afterward.

Q: Can you help with a messy yard, not just trees?
A: Yes. Along with tree work, one reviewer said we completely transformed the mess in their backyard.
